description: This source file provides utility functions for parsing, classifying, and planning test executions with Vitest in a project. It handles arguments, determines target types, groups test targets, and generates configurations and commands for running tests based on user input and project structure.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path pattern.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a string contains glob pattern characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches common test file naming patterns.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument points to a path, glob, or test file.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path argument to a relative repo path pattern.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Produces an include pattern for test files based on a path argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a test target into specific categories such as extension, boundary, channel, etc., based on its path.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running Vitest tests.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine forwarded args, target test files, and watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Builds an array of test run plans based on the provided arguments, grouping targets by type, and associating configs.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates detailed test run specifications including env variables and include file paths.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes include patterns to a JSON file for Vitest to include during test runs.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for Vitest based on initial arguments and current working directory.
